summary: Verified new INLINE deposit-address flow (no external redirect). All 11 backend pytest pass with the reinforced assertion (deposit_address must be 0x + 42 hex chars, no payment_url in response). Live curl smoke as pending user returns a real BEP20 address (e.g. 0x5B2fe264dE18CC6e05C2108D3400F1a06ACB3080), coin=USDT, network=BEP20, no payment_url, no hosted_checkout. Frontend E2E for pending user on /(app)/activation-crypto-auto: clicking cauto-pay produces cauto-qr (QR image naturalWidth=260 loaded from api.qrserver.com), cauto-address contains a valid 0x…42-char BEP20 address, cauto-reference starts with SPLV_CRYPTO_, cauto-status shows 'En attente de la confirmation du paiement…', cauto-copy triggers browser alert 'Adresse copiée dans le presse-papiers.'. No element with testID cauto-open-checkout exists, and no 'Portail' / 'Ouvrir la page' text is present anywhere in the DOM — confirming the redirect UI has been removed. Admin (max_level=12) API path correctly returns 400 { detail: 'Votre compte est déjà activé.' } — verified via direct API call.
critical_code_review_comments: biz_transpay.py performs 2 sequential outbound HTTP calls (biz-transPay create + izichange select-crypto) — total endpoint latency ~2-3s. UI startPayment has no explicit user-visible timer/spinner beyond the button's ActivityIndicator; acceptable for MVP but consider a skeleton state to reduce perceived latency.

activation-crypto-auto.tsx line 152-154: cauto-status text '{checking ? " En attente…" : "Envoi confirmé — patientez"}' — the fallback branch ('Envoi confirmé — patientez') is misleading because it fires when the polling interval is cleared (either after unmount OR after successful activation). Consider tri-state (idle/polling/confirmed) to avoid showing 'Envoi confirmé' during a race where interval clears without activation success. Non-blocking.

biz_transpay.py silently swallows the memo field returned by izichange but never surfaces it in the UI — for BEP20 there's no memo so this is fine, but if the flow is ever extended to networks that require memos, the UI will need to render it prominently.
